newsitem.title: USA: York Group acquires West Point Casket.
newsitem.headline: York Group acquires West Point Casket.

text.p: The York Group Inc said on Wednesday it has completed the acquisition of West Point Casket Co, an independent casket distributor of York products and manufacturer of metal and cloth-covered caskets.
York Group is the nation's second-largest manufacturer of caskets and casket components, the company said.
Terms of the deal were not immediately available.
A York Group spokesman later said the company acquired West Point for a combination of cash and stock. A dollar value of the deal was not disclosed.
West Point and its subsidiary had about $30 million in annual revenues, but a portion of sales were from York Group, a company spokesman said.
